annotations.target_phrase: The tug Marcus Garvey, a steel drum nine meters long
annotations.annotation_text: The Marcus Garvey, an orbital tugboat operated by the Rastafarian Zionites, representing subcultural resistance and counter-hegemonic technology operating on the margins of corporate aerospace.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 121.

annotations.target_phrase: Sister, time, it be time, ya know wha mean? Dread
annotations.annotation_text: Zionite temporal philosophy: Maelcum's Rastafarian rejection of mechanical, corporate clock-time in favor of organic, spiritual presence ('time be time'), contrasting with the rigid microsecond precision of cyberdecks.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 121.
